The journey turns into an intimate passage that confronts her with memory, grief, uprooting and identity.

Unable to answer, he returns home only to discover that his wife has left him. Émile must now live by the very words he’s been preaching, and thanks to unexpected encounters his life is turned upside down, helping him to reinvent himself.

As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: Hugo

The event will take place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at RAC Arena in Perth, Western Australia.
